terra.problem: Calling the preceding events a worship service adds a description not given in this passage.
The statement that the Israelites came from worshiping in Jerusalem relies on the preceding chapter and needs a reference.
The passage says Hezekiah contributed from his possessions, not that he contributed money.
Saying Hezekiah was paying adds a financial detail. The passage says he contributed from his possessions.
The oven comparison does not match the action: stocking an oven is itself part of baking, rather than providing support so someone can focus on another task.
The claim that an abundance cannot be given in secret is not true, and the text does not say whether anyone gave secretly.
The third and seventh months do not establish exactly four months of bringing and stacking; the text gives no dates within those months.
The text says they blessed the LORD and His people after viewing the heaps, but does not identify this as their first response.
Saying no one was hiding anything goes beyond what Azariah says. The passage does not address that.
